name: Eleventh & Rockford
bio:
Step into the creative sanctuary of Eleventh & Rockford, where the artistry of tattooing is celebrated with exceptional skill in black & gray, neotraditional, and sketch styles. This exclusive studio, nestled in the heart of the vibrant local scene, operates by appointment only to ensure a personalized and immersive experience. Connect with our dedicated artists, Donzo, Blackhearted, and Jon108Osiris, by calling 918-836-9998 and begin the journey of crafting your unique piece of wearable art.
